clips.title: KreekCraft heard something in the GTA 6 swamp… it was not a deer
clips.caption: Off-roading through the swamp was a mistake 😭
clips.voice_intro: KreekCraft is off-roading through the swamp when something out there makes a terrible noise.
clips.voice_outro: Whatever was making that noise, these swamps clearly aren't empty. Taking a road car through them was always asking for trouble.

clips.hook: No way he ran out of gas
clips.title: KreekCraft actually ran out of gas in GTA 6
clips.caption: Saw the gas station. Didn't make it ⛽
clips.voice_intro: His tank is nearly dry, and KreekCraft just spotted a gas station.
clips.voice_outro: Running dry in GTA still feels wrong to me. Fuel stranding KreekCraft mid-drive is brutal, but kind of brilliant too.
